```{=latex}
\vspace{-2cm}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

hours_data <- readRDS(params$data_path)

groups <- list(
  list(
    label = "Clinical Hours",
    cols = c(
      individual = "Individual Therapy",
      relational_couple = "Couple Therapy",
      relational_family = "Family Therapy"
    )
  ),
  list(
    label = "Supervision Hours",
    cols = c(
      supervision_individual = "Individual Supervision",
      supervision_group = "Group Supervision"
    )
  ),
  list(
    label = "Admin/Other Hours",
    cols = c(
      consultation = "Consultation",
      case_notes = "Case Notes",
      session_plan = "Session Planning",
      emails = "Emails",
      letters = "Mail / Letters",
      staff_meetings = "Staff Meetings",
      cont_ed = "Continuing Education",
      exam_prep = "Exam Preparation"
    )
  )
)

category_total <- function(df, col) {
  if (!(col %in% names(df))) return(NA_real_)
  total <- sum(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (total == 0) return(NA_real_)
  total
}

build_summary_rows <- function(df, col_map) {
  totals <- sapply(names(col_map), function(cn) category_total(df, cn))
  keep <- !is.na(totals)
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    Category = unname(col_map[keep]),
    Hours = round(totals[keep], 1),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

summary_rows <- data.frame(Category = character(), Hours = numeric())
pack_ranges <- list()
subtotal_rows <- integer()
grand_total <- 0

for (g in groups) {
  rows <- build_summary_rows(hours_data, g$cols)
  if (is.null(rows)) next

  start <- nrow(summary_rows) + 1
  summary_rows <- bind_rows(summary_rows, rows)
  pack_ranges[[length(pack_ranges) + 1]] <- list(label = g$label, start = start, end = nrow(summary_rows))

  subtotal <- sum(rows$Hours)
  grand_total <- grand_total + subtotal
  summary_rows <- bind_rows(
    summary_rows,
    data.frame(Category = paste(g$label, "Subtotal"), Hours = round(subtotal, 1))
  )
  subtotal_rows <- c(subtotal_rows, nrow(summary_rows))
}

summary_rows <- bind_rows(summary_rows, data.frame(Category = "Grand Total", Hours = round(grand_total, 1)))
grand_total_row <- nrow(summary_rows)
```

**Clinician:** `r params$clinician_name`

**Report Period:** `r format(as.Date(params$start_date), "%B %d, %Y")` to `r format(as.Date(params$end_date), "%B %d, %Y")`

## Hours Summary

```{r}
#| echo: false
tbl <- kbl(
  summary_rows,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "r"),
  col.names = c("Category", "Hours")
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE)

for (r in subtotal_rows) {
  tbl <- tbl %>% row_spec(r, bold = TRUE, hline_after = TRUE)
}
tbl <- tbl %>% row_spec(grand_total_row, bold = TRUE, hline_after = TRUE)

for (p in pack_ranges) {
  tbl <- tbl %>% pack_rows(p$label, p$start, p$end)
}

tbl
```
